title: A Static Carrier Model in Recursive Interval Geometry: Activation Channels and Electromagnetic Readout
content: We formulate a static carrier model of the Thomson-limit electromagnetic coupling within Recursive Interval Geometry. Nonzero activation patterns at one level become generating channels at the next, giving a link, a triangle, and an octahedral carrier with counts of 3, 7, and 127. A single-opening facewise construction has seven edge-generating faces and one terminal cap with no additional autonomous bit. Signed octahedral face coordinates realize the seven triangular patterns as seven generating-face addresses. The resulting mode inventory contains 137 modes, and the joint reference resolution is 2667. Equal-distance pairing with a fixed midpoint gives a relative phase of half a turn and an endpoint support change of minus two. A tetrahedral connector inherits its host interface and retains two independent inputs. Full-interface normalization gives a capacity of one half and a host contribution of 63.5, independent of the host cap response. A three-level static readout combines the pairing relation, support change, and complete-carrier self and interface terms with a common normalization factor. An electromagnetic readout postulate identifies the resulting weighted norm with the inverse low-energy coupling, yielding 137.035999176253…. The main text develops the physical construction and empirical comparison; three appendices develop the carrier and interface geometry, the RIG metric and finite relative norm readout, and auxiliary sampling calculations.
